name: smart-study-planner
description: Smart Study Planner — monorepo: Express API (server/) + React SPA (client/). Ildiz manifesti deploy uchun: build va start skriptlari.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client ci --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && node server/src/prefetch-mongo.js
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
